svg.title: LEVI in context: data in, reviewed labels and training data out, a person in charge
svg.desc: Raw captures, LeRobot datasets and robot rollouts enter LEVI; models propose; a person approves; LeRobot v2.1, RECAP value data, training manifests and pool exports leave. Source data is never modified.
